title: Great Clean and Relaxing Scent but...
text: Great Clean and Relaxing Scent but.... The scent doesn't last long and it is too expensive on Amazon.  I can go to my home town, Brooklyn and find a street vendor.  I can purchase this size for $10  or the larger size for $15.
